description: Issue one of your invoices through your connected Stripe account so the customer pays on Stripe's page: returns the hosted invoice URL. send true also asks Stripe to email it. Safe to retry; an invoice is issued once. Early access. Needs a Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

invoice_id.description: The invoice UUID: id on a list_invoices result.

send.description: Also email it to the customer (default false).

name: issue_invoice_with_stripe
